title: 60 mob bosses got caught with their pants down. In the woods. 🌲
caption:
Apalachin, 1957: the day America found out the Mafia was real 🕴️
Tag the friend who'd run first 👇
first_comment: Tag the friend who'd be first into the woods 👇
sources: FBI, 'The Apalachin Meeting' / 'Mafia Summit Uncovered' (14 November 1957, Joseph Barbara's estate; Sgt. Edgar Croswell; about 60 detained)
